Paragraph: As the blazing fire turns firewood to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge burn to ashes all reactions to material activities.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Anxiety over the inevitable psychological and karmic consequences of past actions.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'As the blazing fire turns firewood to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge burn to ashes all reactions to material activities.'
Outcome/Resolution: The awakening of true self-knowledge completely neutralizes the psychological weight and consequences of past deeds.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Cognitive Restructuring: Using transformative insight to incinerate destructive mental baggage
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Cleansing: Purging lingering anxiety and psychological burdens accumulated over time
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Freedom from Guilt: Attaining a fresh start by understanding one's true, unblemished essential identity

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Yathaidhamsi samiddho 'gnir bhasmasat kurute (Just as a blazing fire reduces fuel to ashes)
Jnagnih sarva-karmani bhasmasat kurute (The fire of knowledge reduces all karma/reactions to ashes)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The fire of divine knowledge consumes all karmic reactions, both good and bad, setting the soul entirely free.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Deep self-realization acts as a catalyst that burns away maladaptive guilt and internal conflicts.
